comment: Upstream tracking map for zpui / apps/zeron (docs/UPSTREAM.md). Patterns are globs relative to the upstream repo root ('*' = within one path segment, '**' = any depth). The most specific match wins (most literal characters, then fewest wildcards); catch_all entries only apply when nothing else matches and are reported as unmapped. status: ported | partial | not-ported | n/a. zig: the zpui / apps/zeron files that port the upstream file (empty = nothing ported yet, or nothing to port).

deps.action: markdown parser is a line-for-line port of pulldown-cmark 0.12.2: re-port apps/zeron/src/markdown/cmark/, re-run apps/zeron/scripts/gen_cmark_tables.py and gen_md_corpus.py + markdown_parity.rs
apps/zeron/src/diff/similar.zig ports similar 2.7.0: re-check algorithms, re-run diff parity
bump vendor/tree-sitter/runtime to match, re-run syntax parity
apps/zeron/src/syntax/highlight.zig ports tree-sitter-highlight: re-check, re-run syntax parity
update the grammar in vendor/tree-sitter/grammars (and its queries), re-run syntax parity
informational: Mermaid rendering is not ported yet

generators.name: shaders
generators.run: manual: re-sync src/scene.zig GPU structs, copy shaders.metal (keep the license header) to src/renderer/metal/shaders.metal, hand-port WGSL changes to src/renderer/vulkan/shaders/*.glsl, then `zig build test` (golden image)

generators.name: theme_parity
generators.run: rebuild apps/zeron/scripts/theme_parity.rs against {zeron}/target (see its header) > apps/zeron/src/theme/parity_data.zig

generators.name: gen_assets
generators.run: copy changed crates/ui/assets/{icons,fonts,file-icons} into apps/zeron/assets/, then python3 apps/zeron/scripts/gen_assets.py {zeron} > apps/zeron/src/assets.zig

generators.name: markdown_parity
generators.run: python3 apps/zeron/scripts/gen_md_corpus.py <pulldown-cmark-0.12.2> apps/zeron/src/markdown/testdata && rebuild apps/zeron/scripts/markdown_parity.rs (see its header)

generators.name: diff_parity
generators.run: python3 apps/zeron/scripts/gen_diff_corpus.py {zeron} apps/zeron/src/diff/testdata && rebuild apps/zeron/scripts/diff_parity.rs (see its header)
